description_en: Queries the analysis result of a schema synchronization task
description_zh: 调用GetStructSyncJobAnalyzeResult获取结构同步的任务分析结果
name: GetStructSyncJobAnalyzeResult

parameters.help_en:
The type of the comparison. Valid values:

CREATE_TABLE: compares the created tables.
ALTER_TABLE: compares the modified tables.
EQUAL_TABLE: compares the identical tables.
PASS_TABLE: compares the tables that are skipped during schema synchronization.
NOT_COMPARE: does not compare tables
parameters.help_zh:
比较类型，取值：
CREATE_TABLE：创建表
ALTER_TABLE：修改表
EQUAL_TABLE：相同的表
PASS_TABLE：跳过的表
NOT_COMPARE：待分析的表
parameters.name: compare_type

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the tenant ID, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

StructSyncJobAnalyzeResult.description_en: The analysis result of the schema synchronization task
StructSyncJobAnalyzeResult.description_zh: 结构同步任务分析结果

ResultList.description_en: The details of the analysis results

items.description_en: The details of an analysis result

SourceTableName.description_en: The name of the source table

TargetTableName.description_en: The name of the destination table

SummaryList.description_en: The statistics on the analysis results

items.description_en: The statistics on an analysis result
